ache.title: “Are you going to pull for Acheron?” Nope, says me
ache.note: Acheron isn’t even out and this tier list already asks if you’ll pull for her. Nero admits the Nihility archetype ‘ends up being pretty specific’, so she wants a whole team built around her. That’s how one character becomes four: the tier list ranks the friends you’ll ‘need’ next.
watch: hype before the banner even opens
an archetype that needs extra units
ache.tip: Wait until a character is out and you’ve seen her in your own game. Let the hype pass before you decide anything.
lines: your planned team can be the one you have
